river_partitions:modern_world_wave2.description: Reviewed twelve-parent Modern World river pack; retains all original pilot cells and adds Oder, Yangtze and Yellow River sites.

river_partitions:modern_world_pilot.description: Reviewed six-parent river-paint pilot bound to the Modern World baseline; independent from reference topology.

river_partitions:modern_world_wave5.description: Reviewed 376-parent Modern World river pack in lossless indexed transport; preserves all 302 wave3 parent records.

river_partitions:modern_world_wave6.description: Reviewed 382-parent Modern World river pack in lossless indexed transport; preserves all 376 wave5 parent records and excludes seven held internal-seam overlap candidates.

river_partitions:modern_world_wave7.description: Reviewed 389-parent Modern World river pack in lossless indexed transport; preserves all 382 wave6 parent records and admits seven overlaps with ordered parent visibility and layered internal contours.

metadata.method: Official 2024 scores for all six WGI dimensions passed through on the 0-100 scale; modern_world uses geographic country codes, while supported historical scenarios use baseline owner reference mapping; no project composite or historical measurement.

historical_reference_policy.join_method: Baseline owner tag -> scenarioCountriesByTag[tag].base_iso2 (explicit two-letter ISO2) -> existing ISO2-to-ISO3 mapping -> official WGI country/economy score.
historical_reference_policy.unknown_mapping_policy: Leave unmapped owners blank; do not infer from tags, parent countries, or modern feature geography.
historical_reference_policy.interpretation: 2024 governance reference values mapped to scenario baseline owners; not observed governance measurements for historical years.

metadata.method: Official UNDP HDR 2025 country values for 2023 passed through as raw values; main-map colors use raw-value bins, with official HDI thresholds at 0.55, 0.7 and 0.8. Component bins are fixed cartographic ranges, not official UNDP categories. Auxiliary normalized values use HDI x 100 and the report's dimension goalposts on a clipped 0-100 scale for other consumers. Modern World uses geographic country codes; historical scenarios use baseline owner reference mapping.
